fatty-acids-bilayer.alt: Left: a saturated fatty acid drawn as a straight zigzag chain and an unsaturated fatty acid with a bend at its cis double bond, each with a COOH end. Middle: a phospholipid with a round polar head and two tails, one bent. Right: a bilayer of phospholipids with heads facing water above and below and tails meeting in the middle.

lipid-types.alt: Left: a triglyceride, a three-carbon glycerol backbone with three fatty acid tails attached by ester bonds. Right: cholesterol, four fused carbon rings (three six-sided and one five-sided) with an OH group at one end and a short hydrocarbon tail at the other.
